title: Sample Return
description: Hayabusa2 brought back grains of the asteroid Ryugu; OSIRIS-REx brought back Bennu's; Chang'e 5 brought back the Moon. A probe flies the transfer orbit out, takes its sample, and flies it home: half an ellipse each way, so the time of the trip is set by Kepler's third law. Unlocks the Mission Bay and the Sample Return Probe.

puzzle.goal: A Hohmann transfer between circular orbits of radii r1 and r2 about a body of parameter μ is half an ellipse of semi-major axis (r1 + r2)/2. Write the time t it takes (half the period).
puzzle.name: Time of flight
puzzle.ask: Find t in days for r1 = 1 AU, r2 = @{r2} AU and μ of the Sun = 39.48 AU³/year² (give years × 365.25).
puzzle.method: Kepler's third law: P = 2π√(a³/μ). Half of it, with a = (r1 + r2)/2.
